overall_notes: The paper focuses on abstractive summarization using PMI decoding with salience awareness and reinforcement learning. The extracted metadata was largely accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and addition of missing model names. The paper uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore, FactKB) and LLM-as-judge (GPT-4) for evaluation. No human evaluation was conducted.
